import numpy as np
d=384; H=6; hd=64
def head(l,j):
    s=slice(j*hd,(j+1)*hd)
    g=W[f'ln1_w.{l}']
    Q=W[f'W_q.{l}'][s]*g; K=W[f'W_k.{l}'][s]*g; V=W[f'W_v.{l}'][s]*g; O=W[f'W_o.{l}'][:,s]
    return Q,K,V,O
OV5=head(0,5)[3]@head(0,5)[2]
OV1=head(0,1)[3]@head(0,1)[2]
for (l,j) in [(2,1),(3,1),(3,5),(3,0)]:
    Q,K,V,O=head(l,j)
